name: dsh-reference-checker
description: Reference verification for DeepSeek Harness (参考文献真实性检查器): the refcheck_check model tool checks a paper's bibliography (.pdf/.bib/.tex/.txt/.md or pasted text) against Crossref, OpenAlex and arXiv, reports found/partial/not_found/error per entry, and emits corrected citations in the input's style (APA, GB/T 7714, IEEE, Vancouver, MLA, Chicago, Harvard, ACS, BibTeX).
author: Yu-tao-Li
